poems.title: Nevermore
poems.note: the night beach, dunes up from the surf

set_pieces.name: Shore of broken pieces
set_pieces.line: 4 NEVERMORE · A Shore of broken pieces — “What if i followed this / trail”

set_pieces.name: The silence
set_pieces.line: 4 NEVERMORE · B The silence — “the waves will / calm to folded whispers”

set_pieces.name: The heart on the sand
set_pieces.line: 4 NEVERMORE · C The heart on the sand — “to find a throbbing heart”

set_pieces.name: Trail up the incline
set_pieces.line: 4 NEVERMORE · D Trail up the incline — “the midlife / corner we turn toward / the incline—”

set_pieces.name: Night garden field
set_pieces.line: 4 NEVERMORE · E Night garden field — “into the vast moonlit / night's / garden fields.”

set_pieces.name: Searching for hands
set_pieces.line: 4 NEVERMORE · F Searching for hands — “The clouds mute the stars”

set_pieces.name: Standing in the field
set_pieces.line: 4 NEVERMORE · G Standing in the field — “nevermore.”

foundry_refs.desc: Literal match: Minimalist 'Poems by Mark Anthony Thomas' authorial typography over rain-slicked asphalt.
foundry_refs.line: It used to be mine. I lift it with care: nevermore.

foundry_refs.desc: Literal visual match: The POET standing in dim teal bedroom moving toward rain window overlooking black car.
foundry_refs.line: The vape gathers, inside and out. My vision blurs. I move toward the window — and you only get further away.
